text: The UNDP Insurance and Risk Finance Facility (IRFF) in Nepal is a country-level initiative aimed at enhancing financial resilience against high-impact hazards such as earthquakes, floods, landslides, and droughts. It is part of UNDP's global IRFF portfolio, working with governments and the insurance industry to create inclusive insurance and disaster risk finance solutions. The initiative focuses on diagnostics, policy reforms, capacity building, and innovation to develop a robust insurance and risk-finance ecosystem in Nepal.
